title: 3.0.0 NS Client no Control
symptom: With NSClient 3.0.0, Profiles/Temporary Rate on the Master cannot be controlled/changed. Even the last action such as changing the pump is not displayed. With RC3 it worked without problems. Also NS shows all NS client data.
cause: Some NSClient synchronisation settings are removed in AAPS Config Builder, such as Profile Switch and Temp Target.
fix: Enable the removed synchronisation settings in preferences with version 3.0.0.1, or update to the latest master (479bfc410) where it is back to normal.
evidence_quote: with 3.0.0.1 you can enable it in preferences
